Kauravaśreshṭha, i.e. Duryodhana).--§ 573 (Ambopākhyānap.): V, 196, 7650 (followed Yudhishṭhira).--§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 93, 4151 (followed Bhīmasena).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 987 (description of his horses, proceeded against Droṇa); 990 (followed Dhṛshṭadyumna).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 185 (has been slain--gato Vaivasvatakshayaṃ).
